name: Saburo's Ghost
ability: When deployed, purge 2 hostile Programs from the Net. While this card is active, hostile Quickhacks cost +2 RAM.
flavor: "The relic remembers what flesh forgets."

name: Arasaka Cyber-Ninja
ability: Cannot be targeted by hostile Quickhacks during the turn it is deployed.
flavor: "Silent as a cold disconnect."

name: Subdermal ICE Wall
ability: Equipped Operative gains +4 DEF and immunity to Breach attacks.
flavor: "Military-grade lattice woven under the dermal layer."

name: Soulkiller Daemon
ability: Target hostile Operative. Erase their engram (destroy card) and add their base ATK to your RAM pool this turn.
flavor: "You won't feel a thing. You won't feel anything ever again."

name: Mikoshi Data Fortress
ability: Generates +1 RAM at the start of your turn. You may tap Mikoshi to draw 1 Arasaka card.
flavor: "The cloud where digital ghosts reside."

name: Arasaka Riot Trooper
ability: Hostile Operatives must target Riot Trooper before attacking your Leader.
flavor: "Standard pacification unit. Disobedience is not tolerated."

name: Data Interceptor Unit
ability: On deploy: Reveal the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.
flavor: "Watching every packet on the grid."

name: Col. Jackson Kane
ability: Whenever a friendly Militech Operative attacks, all friendly units gain +1 ATK until end of turn.
flavor: "Peace through overwhelming firepower."

name: Militech Minotaur Mech
ability: Deals 2 overflow damage to the opponent's main terminal when it destroys a defending Operative.
flavor: "Walking iron, spitting 50-caliber diplomacy."

name: Arm-Mounted Micro-Missile
ability: Equipped Operative deals 3 instant direct damage upon entering combat.
flavor: "Point, lock, vaporize."

name: Orbital Strike Uplink
ability: Deal 5 damage split among all hostile Operatives.
flavor: "Raining tungsten rods from low orbit."

name: Militech SpecOps Recon
ability: Can attack immediately on the turn it is deployed.
flavor: "In and out before the sirens spin up."

name: Armory Depot 4
ability: Reduce the Eurodollar cost of all Cyberware cards in your hand by 1.
flavor: "Locked, loaded, and discounted in bulk."

name: Agent Bryce Mosley
ability: Nullifies enemy Quickhacks on a 50% dice roll. Opponents cannot play more than 2 Quickhacks per turn.
flavor: "The Blackwall stays intact. Whatever the cost."

name: Blackwall Sentinel
ability: When this card blocks an Operative, that Operative loses all cyberware attachments.
flavor: "Beyond the digital fence lies chaos. Do not open the gate."

name: System Override Command
ability: Exhaust target enemy Operative. They cannot attack or use abilities during their next turn.
flavor: "Kernel panic initiated. Goodbye locomotion."

name: Netwatch Quarantine Node
ability: Whenever an opponent plays a Quickhack, they suffer 1 damage to their main terminal.
flavor: "Trace routine activated. Location tagged."

name: Cyber-Investigator
ability: When deployed, pick a card type. The next card of that type played by your opponent costs +1 RAM.
flavor: "Following the digital breadcrumbs through Night City's grime."

name: Johnny 'Silverhand' Engram
ability: When attacking Corporate Operatives (Arasaka/Militech), gains double ATK. Cannot be mind-hacked.
flavor: "Wake up, Samurai. We have a city to burn."

name: Rogue - Queen of Afterlife
ability: Friendly Edgerunner cards cost 1 less RAM. Once per turn, you may draw a card when you deploy an Edgerunner.
flavor: "Everyone in this bar owes me something."

name: Sandevistan Neural Booster
ability: Equipped Operative attacks twice in combat and cannot be intercepted.
flavor: "The world slows down to a crawl. You don't."

name: Overheat Daemon
ability: Deal 2 damage now and 2 damage at the beginning of the target's next turn.
flavor: "Blood boiling at 105 degrees Celsius."

name: Mantis Blades Mk.4
ability: Equipped Operative bypasses target's DEF shields directly to their core health.
flavor: "Carbon-composite edges slicing through heavy composite plating."

name: Afterlife Nightclub
ability: Restores 2 DEF to your wounded Operatives at the end of every round.
flavor: "To legendary drinks and short, glorious lives."

name: Street Scav Netrunner
ability: On defeat: Salvage 1 random Quickhack from your graveyard into your hand.
flavor: "One man's fried cyberdeck is another punk's golden ticket."

name: Dr. Meredith Vance
ability: All friendly units heal 2 DEF at the start of your turn. When an Operative receives Cyberware, draw 1 card.
flavor: "Evolution is too slow. We are drafting the upgrade patch."

name: Synthetic Chitin Exoskeleton
ability: Equipped Operative gains +6 DEF and reflects 1 damage back to attackers.
flavor: "Cloned arthropod DNA bonded with diamond nanothreads."

name: Cellular Regeneration Serum
ability: Restore 5 DEF to any friendly Operative or repair 3 DEF on an Infrastructure.
flavor: "Instant stem cell mitosis in a needle."

name: Hydroponic Lab 07
ability: Generates 1 Bio-Credit token per turn. Spend 2 tokens to grant an Operative +1/+1 permanently.
flavor: "Feeding the starving megacity while funding genetic revolutions."

name: Genetically Altered Pit-Brawler
ability: Whenever this unit takes damage and survives, it gains +2 ATK.
flavor: "Adrenaline glands firing at 400% baseline."

name: Synaptic Disconnector
ability: Detach all Cyberware from target Operative and place them back into their owner's hand.
flavor: "One pulse, severed neural conduits."

name: Gorilla Arms Titan-Grip
ability: Equipped Operative deals crushing damage, ignoring shields and barriers.
flavor: "Hydraulic knuckles capable of tearing steel bulkheads open."

name: Ping Relay Beacon
ability: Draw 1 card. Reveal 1 random card from opponent's hand.
flavor: "Pinging local subnet... network topology mapped."

name: Ripperdoc Back-Alley Clinic
ability: Whenever you play a Cyberware card, reduce its cost by 1 RAM (minimum 1).
flavor: "No license, no questions, cash upfront."

name: Black ICE Hydra Daemon
ability: Attacks can target up to two enemy Operatives simultaneously.
flavor: "Cut off one neural probe, two more strike from the deep net."

name: Militech Combat Drone Swarm
ability: Takes -1 damage from non-ranged attacks.
flavor: "Autonomous micro-rotors humming in lethal harmony."
